# Feasly

> Feasly is a free feasibility estimator for Calgary infill home builds.
> Enter a Calgary address, pick a home size and finish tier, and get a
> deterministic range-based cost estimate (land, build, and total) —
> before you commit to a project.

- Canonical site: https://feasly.com/ (unverified as of 2026-09-24; dev build served from Azure Static Web Apps)
- Estimates are ranges, not guarantees. Dollar figures are calculated
  deterministically from a versioned cost model — never generated by AI.

## Key routes

- `/` — Landing + address search (Calgary address autocomplete)
- `/estimate/scope` — Wizard step 1: home size slider + finish tier (Standard / Premium / Luxury)
- `/estimate/details` — Wizard step 2: scope summary (placeholder; full details arrive with the lead-gate build)
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy
- `/terms` — Terms of service

## Notes for agents

- `/estimate/*` routes are app state behind a single lead gate; they carry
  `noindex` and are not crawl targets.
- Property data is currently served from a mock harness in dev builds;
  live City of Calgary assessment data is the planned production source.
- Public API is versioned at `/api/v1` (estimate + lead endpoints); see the
  repo contracts package for the exact shapes.
